additional_info.subject: 0408759 - ID0408759-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R8 170002507] The two charging points are out of service CRM:00641001158
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Greetings of the day!
Please do the following troubleshooting, knowing also the following conditions to close:
F03-KF5 DI b.7: true:
Safety relay trip QA26 (no emergency stop, doors are closed, external E-Stop is not activated)
3 LEDs on the QA26 schould be on: 1, 2 & 3
KF5 DI b.4: false:
breaker not closed yet
If the feedback was not present after closing, the Error Flag will raise
unfortunately the flag will fall again shortly after (Sicharge Software <2.5.4)
to check the Error Flag search for '
PLC-Error-Flag
' in syslogs during PLC operation mode 5: '
SWITCH_ON_MAIN_BREAKER
' as stated here:
PLC Logic
KF5 DI b.3: false:
if AC contactor could not be opened (error happened), the main breaker will also Trip
KF2 DQ b.1: false
: turning off the main breaker
MCCB is tripping: MCCB opens → TRIP LED turns yellow for 1s, turns off after (self recovery from TRIP after 1s); ACT LED is constantly green; reasons for tripping:
undervoltage release F09-QA1 is not receiving/interrupts 24V feedback from safety relay trip F03-QA26.24
it should turn 24V on if all emergency signals present (doors & e-stops)
two parallel signals coming from QA26: .14 →  PLC KF5 DI15 / .24 → QA1 D1
as the undervoltage release is an optional piece of mechanic for the main breaker, please make sure that it it inserted in the MCCB correctly
the "turn on MCCB" 230V signals might be inconsistent (thus dropping to false both turning the main breaker off)
switched L1/L2 is not an issue, charger operates normally
→ for both issues:
check the wire lines with all connectors inbetween, check both starting & end devices for the signal to arrive & stay
you can bridge some signals for testing purposes to eliminate issues & get to the real cause
on MCCB turning off the converters have usually some power left to change their status & alarm flag and communicate it to the PLC
you can check the charger logs searching for "PLC-Error-Flags"
Please check the GQ1 fan connection, it has been reported in the error flag
Please take a spare KF2, undervoltage relay, motor for MCCB (or whole MCCB). QA26, and QA28/29,
Mainfan_GQ1
,KF13
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
